notes: *wherein were* is a single `added` unit: the Hebrew juxtaposes nachash saraph to the wilderness with no relative, no preposition and no verb morpheme to license either word (rules 20 and 55). The ASV italics corroborate without deciding, by rule 7.
The single *the* of *the rock of flint* goes to the article morpheme on challamish under rule 29's fronting case, the rectum being rendered anarthrously; the construct keeps only *rock*.
One *the* is written for ba-midbar ha-gadol we-ha-nora, so the first article takes it and the two agreement articles are unrepresented (rule 47).
The existential `אַיִן` heads on the negation *no* rather than on any supplied frame word (rule 50).
